source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Whenever a model has a ranged attack allocated to it and, because of this FORTIFICATION, some attacking model cannot fully see it, it gains the Benefit of Cover for that attack.

fields.condition: at least one attacking model lacks a full view of the target model because of this FORTIFICATION
